# Optional Clean Code playbooks

These references are loaded **only** when a user invokes the corresponding skill command or asks for that procedure. The custom agents own roles and stage gates; these files are not additional agents.

- `review.md` — code review and findings, read-only.
- `refactor.md` — scoped behaviour-preserving source edits.
- `recover.md` — recover contractual intent from legacy systems.

Former `design`, `plan`, `challenge` and `implement` modes are now handled by Analyst, Architect, Engineer and Delivery agents; do not maintain parallel execution loops.
